pr_title: grow column as same rate as table
pr_body:
fixes #1692 

issue was that when growing the table:
https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/6121e5f933bfa215576a83cbed65292a498e2b52/crates/bevy_ecs/src/storage/table.rs#L327-L337

the column was not grown at the same size
https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/6121e5f933bfa215576a83cbed65292a498e2b52/crates/bevy_ecs/src/storage/blob_vec.rs#L59-L64

Reserving the amount ask fixes the bug and keep the size equals. The check for `available_space` can probably be removed too.

issue_context.title: commands.spawn_batch() causes panic
comments: We should ensure that this is fixed as part of #1562. Adding the 0.5 milestone to this as a result.
Note that I changed the `add_system` to `add_startup_system` to show that this fails after spawn_batch is repeated X times.

review_comments: This is not quite right. If the length is 2 and the capacity is 10, reserving 11 elements should give a capacity of 12, not 20. `Vec::reserve` grows the backing allocation enough to be able to push a certain amount of new elements. It doesn't make sense for `BlobVec` to do something different.
Agreed. I think this is an issue with how Table tracks capacity / how it calls reserve on its Columns / Entities.
I thought `BlobVec` was something specific to `Table` and as such didn't need to keep those counts, as it's only used within `Table`... but `BlobVec` is public while `Table` is not
I think i have a solution. Creating a new pr now.
